findings.detail: isLoading uses query.isLoading rather than unresolved status. With no data, isPending=true, isLoading=false and fetchStatus=paused, the Profile, Details and Activity bodies reach their empty branches. The Profile claims no profile synced yet before the read has answered. StaleRefreshWarning returns null without retained data. PageLayout query supplies freshness metadata only, not a pending body guard.

sourceRepro.trace: hasData=false -> isLoading=false -> fatalError=null -> hasProfile=false -> three empty bodies; summary unknown and Sync unknown coexist with asserted empty Profile.

findings.fix: Use existing DataState initial/isRefreshBlocked to render unresolved or paused feedback in persistent shells. Reserve empty/never-synced copy for a successfully resolved empty envelope; keep GET retry and all POST actions.

findings.detail: Truthiness of fetchedAt controls the Hero synced pill and summary sync metric/status, but validity is checked only for summary freshness. A populated profile with an empty fetch timestamp says Never synced in Hero/summary and Unknown in Sync. A nonempty invalid string says Synced with success-color dot while date text is an em dash and freshness is explicitly unknown. Missing/invalid source time cannot establish never synced or confirmed sync.

findings.detail: Eight page and nine summary formatter call sites invoke pure dateFormat helpers without locale/timezone options. Absolute timestamps therefore use browser locale/timezone instead of saved display preferences. Relative labels consult global locale but long-age fallback and all absolute contexts do not receive saved timezone. No hour-cycle preference support was established by the inspected adapter; do not claim it is preserved.

sourceRepro.trace: Page/summary -> formatDateTime(value) with opts omitted -> intlLocale(undefined) and no timeZone -> browser defaults; useDateFormat would supply effective locale/tz.

findings.fix: Adopt existing useDateFormat in both feature owners or pass its existing options, retaining raw ISO instants, relative/full context and null placeholders. Separately verify existing 12/24-hour preference ownership rather than inventing a formatter.

The shared wrapping md variant guarantees only min-h-10 (40px at a 16px root); the Sync button explicitly requests min-h-11. This is a missing 44px source minimum, not a measured hit rectangle or asserted WCAG AA failure.

findings.detail: POST /tesla/user/profile/refresh omits requiresLiveMode. request defaults that flag false, so assertOperationalWriteAllowed returns early; the offline unsafe-path list does not cover this refresh. Page guards only pending state, not canWrite. A historical/read-only view can therefore attempt current Fleet profile refresh. This is a frontend guard bypass, not proof of backend permission bypass, queued replay or a performed Fleet request.
